description: List, add or take off the SSH keys that can log in to a running machine. With only instance_id: the keys on it (fingerprint, comment, the saved key's name). add_ssh_key_ids / add_public_keys: more keys can log in (a teammate's, a new laptop's), at once. remove_fingerprints: those keys can't log in any more (rotate a key: add the new one and remove the old one in one call); taking keys off takes up to half a minute, and at least one key must stay. Free: it changes no billing. Keys are never returned, only fingerprints.

add_public_keys.description: Public keys that can log in too (the .pub file's line).

add_ssh_key_ids.description: Saved keys (list_ssh_keys) that can log in too.

remove_fingerprints.description: Fingerprints (SHA256:...) of keys on the machine to take off.

name: instance_ssh_keys
title: SSH keys on a machine
